verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs describe a full stablecoin acceptance flow: generating a live quote and unique blockchain address (or reusable 'channel' address) for a payment, accepting stablecoin payments and settling in fiat, plus webhook notifications and signature validation to confirm settlement programmatically, all authenticated via Hawk and testable in a sandbox before going live. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer account of building an actual checkout integration, and no explicit end-to-end code sample tying quote creation through webhook confirmation into one flow.
